truth: Sleeper players_points from /league/<id>/matchups/<week> (every rostered player, starters and bench)

reproduceInvestigationB.filter: stat line present, gp > 0, scorer returned a result (scripts/idp_replacement_research.py L446-469)

statFeed.note: Sleeper's feed records a sack's TFL and QB hit as separate stats; the card then pays each key independently (stacking is a property of the STAT line, not of a scoring rule).

optimalTotalFromAwardedPlayerPoints.meaning: exact solver + our eligibility over Sleeper's own per-player points vs Sleeper's team total — isolates lineup solver/eligibility from scoring

optimalTotalFromComputedPlayerPoints.meaning: the full production chain: our scorer + our solver vs Sleeper's total

eligibility.caveat: fantasy_positions read from the CURRENT /players/nfl directory; Sleeper does not publish a dated eligibility history, so a mid-season eligibility change is invisible to this check.

nflverse.path: src.bdvm.actuals.weekly_points_from_rows (the bdvm_api in-season blend) + pbp_weekly supplement; joined by src.utils.name_clean.normalize_player_name
nflverse.nflverseSource: https://github.com/nflverse/nflverse-data/releases/download/stats_player/stats_player_week_2026.csv (fetched live; not cached by nflverse_direct — the canonical-JSON sha256 above pins the rows actually scored)

IDPA-DEFECT-01.description: nflverse normalization (sleeper_stat_line_from_row) drops def_* stats for a player whose listed position is not IDP; Sleeper pays idp_* rules to ANY player (e.g. a WR's solo tackle / forced fumble after a turnover)

IDPA-DEFECT-02.description: a BLOCKED field goal / PAT (nflverse fg_blocked / pat_blocked) is not scored as a miss; Sleeper counts it in fgmiss_<band> / xpmiss

IDPA-DEFECT-03.description: a defensive fumble-return TD (nflverse fumble_recovery_tds on an IDP row) is not mapped to idp_def_td

IDPA-DEFECT-04.description: a player Sleeper lists as FB but nflverse lists as RB has first downs scored under bonus_fd_rb (position taken from the provider listing); Sleeper derives bonus_fd_<pos> from ITS position, and the card prices no FB first down
